title: Lead Generation Quiz for a Stove Retailer
description: A five-question 'stove check' that gives visitors an honest recommendation first – and turns curiosity into qualified enquiries.
demoNotice: Portfolio demonstration for a fictional brand. The live demo works like a real funnel, but no data is sent or stored.

thumbnail.alt: Dark landing page with an ember glow and the question 'Welcher Kaminofen passt wirklich zu deinem Zuhause?' next to a quiz

context: Buying a wood-burning stove is a considered decision. Most visitors are early in their research and are not ready for a sales call – a classic 'request a quote' form loses them.
objective: Offer something useful first (a recommendation), and collect qualified enquiries with the information a consultant needs.
objectiveShort: Turn early-stage visitors into qualified enquiries.
audience: Home owners and future home owners planning a stove
Early in the decision: comparing options, unsure about size and requirements
strategy: Replace 'request a quote' with a 'free stove check' – value before contact
Ask the questions a consultant would ask anyway (room size, living situation, goal, timing)
Personalise the result page so the visitor sees immediate value
Position the consultation as optional to reduce pressure

structure.title: Search & social
structure.text: Question-led ads: 'Which stove fits your living room?'

structure.title: 5 questions
structure.text: Living situation, room size, goal and timing – one tap each.

structure.title: Name, e-mail, postcode
structure.text: Asked only after the visitor has invested in the answers.

structure.title: Personal recommendation
structure.text: Power range and next steps based on the answers.

structure.title: Optional appointment

copy.headline: Welcher Kaminofen passt wirklich zu deinem Zuhause?
copy.subheadline: Fünf kurze Fragen – danach bekommst du eine ehrliche Empfehlung.
hooks: Der häufigste Fehler beim Kaminofen? Zu viel Leistung.
Erst die Empfehlung, dann das Gespräch.
copy.tone: Calm and advisory. Explains instead of selling and names a real problem (oversized stoves) to build trust.

visual.typography: Bold sans-serif headlines, generous line height for the explanations.
visual.imagery: A warm ember glow instead of stock photos. In a real project: photos of installed stoves in customers' homes.
visual.layout: Quiz visible above the fold on desktop – the first answer is one tap away.
